title: Sultan Abdul Samad Jamek Mosque
visualBrief: Individual Sultan Abdul Samad Jamek Mosque: current central hall,attached side wings and low connecting galleries;three pale onion domes,paired banded brick minarets with open lantern caps,cusped cream-trimmed arcades,flat roofs,coarse parapets and selected corner chhatris. Brick/cream rhythm,domes and minarets carry identity. Detached service buildings,river works,station,courtyard paving,umbrellas,planting,flags,signs,fine ornament and furnished interiors are excluded. Shapes and membership remain approximate.

sourceFacts.horizontalBasis: Q1143296 retained reference point and current Jamek Mosque POI35184852806566 agree on the river-confluence mosque. Named Jamek Mosque POI identifies the central three-domed prayer hall at the river confluence. The contiguous main hall,its two attached side wings and low connecting strips are included;three roof parts and two32 m minaret plans refine that same structure. Nearby detached service/ablution buildings,river works,station,shops and courtyard pavement stay host content. No exact Wikidata-tagged footprint was retained;this is a current named-POI/map correspondence and approximate fit. Heading 1.257641544721982 rad follows the minimum-area rectangle of the central hall;positive Z faces the mapped minaret/entry side. Facing,part membership and roof partitions remain approximate visualization judgments.
sourceFacts.architecturalHeights: Retained height/width/length facts are empty. Current PMTiles tags are 8 m for main/side bodies,5 m for connecting strips,11 m for three roof parts,and32 m for both minarets. All tags remain unchanged. The 11 m roof-part tags have unresolved component/datum semantics and guide the estimated drum tops;white onion shells and finials rise to19.1 m for the central dome and17 m for the side domes. This is a picture-guided estimate above nominal mapped parts,not a measured height. Both minarets retain32 m estimated total height;small corner chhatris and parapets are estimated.
